Sophie Park: Heads-up — MedSys dropped a 40p compliance questionnaire asking about audit logs, retention windows, exportability, and per-tenant access. Link to doc: https://drive.company/medsys-qna. Can we triage? @Derek @Jen thoughts?
Derek Nguyen: Quick skim — they want event-level audit logs for 12 months, immutable retention option, an export API (S3/CSV), and tenant-scoped access controls. We currently keep most infra logs ~90d, some audit events 180d. No immutable retention today.
Arjun Patel: FYI sales — MedSys is in an advanced PoC and this is a gating security ask for Private deployment. If we can give a clear path, it accelerates procurement.
Maria Lopez: SE note: For Dedicated/Private we can provide S3 export and longer retention via customer buckets. Hosted product would need new storage + compliance scoping. Current RBAC is org-admin only; no per-tenant role separation.
Jen Cho: From legal/privacy: SOC2/HIPAA customers commonly ask for 6–12mo. Immutable retention often means customer-managed storage or HSM-backed keys for on-cloud offerings. My recommendation: provide a clear short-term playbook + pursue product work if ARR justifies it.
Sophie Park: Proposed options: (A) Product backlog ticket to add 12mo audit retention + per-tenant log access + export API (medium effort). (B) Short-term: ship a customer-facing runbook that documents hosted limitations and offers Dedicated/Private + PS export as a workaround (fast). Which should we prioritize?
Derek Nguyen: Technical constraints: immutable retention implies object-lock + KMS + retention policy enforcement + audit trail for deletions. Private and Dedicated are straightforward to design for; hosted requires infra and billing changes. Rough estimate: 3 sprints to build storage + APIs + RBAC + tagging and tests.
Sophie Park: OK. Tentative prioritization: short-term (B) to unblock deals; backlog (A) if we hit >$X ARR or >3 concurrent PoCs. Action items: 1) Sales to confirm PoC stage & ARR signal (Arjun) 2) SE to draft runbook + sample export commands (Maria) 3) Eng to write a rough scoping doc & spike (Derek) 4) Legal to draft customer-facing answer template (Jen). I will create the triage ticket and proposed launch criteria.
Arjun Patel: I will confirm ARR and PoC status by EOD and loop in the account team.
ops-bot: Ticket created: INC-4271 — "medsys: audit-log retention triage" assigned to eng-logs.
Maria Lopez: I'll start a runbook draft with commands for S3 export and retention recommendations. Pasting a quick snippet we can use: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/medsys/2026-02-14.gz ./ && aws s3api put-object-lock-configuration --bucket medsys-archive --object-lock-configuration \"{\"ObjectLockEnabled\": \"Enabled\", \"Rule\": {\"DefaultRetention\": {\"Mode\": \"GOVERNANCE\", \"Days\": 365}}}\"`
Sophie Park: Thanks everyone — I'll add this to the roadmap triage board and tag as "security intake — audit logs". If legal or eng want to change priority call it out in INC-4271.
Jen Cho: I'll draft the standard response and include recommended contract language re: retention responsibilities.
Derek Nguyen: I'll spin up a short tech spike and post findings to the ticket by next Tues.
